description: Write LinkedIn headline options from the user's answers, each in a proven pattern (title and focus, title and result, title and who you help…), with its length and roughly what shows in search before the cut. Uses only the answers given.

audience.description: Optional. Who they help, e.g. "early-stage startups".

focus.description: Optional. Their specialty or industry, e.g. "B2B SaaS onboarding".

next.description: Optional. What they want next, e.g. "open to product roles in London".

results.description: Optional. One or two real results, one per line, with the numbers the user gave.

role.description: The job title the user wants to be found for.

years.description: Optional. Years of experience, as a number.

name: generate_linkedin_headline
title: Write LinkedIn headlines
